product_one_liner.value: Fly.io is a developer-focused public cloud for deploying and running applications and AI agents on hardware-isolated Linux virtual machines.

named_customers.notes: The announcement identifies these companies as using Fly.io for production AI applications.

employee_band.notes: The cited profiles report 56 and 58 employees.

hq_location.notes: Chicago is listed in the cited company profiles; headquarters information differs across directories.

founded_year.notes: The company profile lists 2016; Fly.io's About page dates development of its current public cloud to 2017.

eng_blog.notes: Publishes engineering deep dives into its authentication infrastructure, WireGuard networking and production Rust-router incidents.

public_docs.notes: Public guides and reference documentation cover Machines, Sprites, Managed Postgres, networking and flyctl.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The four listed openings are Fullstack Engineer, Infrastructure Operations Engineer, Account Manager—Strategic Accounts, and Networking Engineer—Proxy and Corrosion; none has a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.value: OpenRouter, through an optional bring-your-own-key Connector
model_provider.notes: Sprites can call models through OpenRouter using the customer's key; this is not a fixed built-in foundation model. Anthropic and OpenAI are disclosed separately for internal tooling only.

compliance_certs.notes: HIPAA support is offered through a BAA, not a standalone certification. Fly.io explicitly says it does not hold ISO 27001 or a PCI DSS AOC.

last_funding.notes: Announced July 24, 2026; co-led by Dell Technologies Capital and Intel Capital.

raised_18mo.notes: The $25 million Series D was announced in July 2026, within the requested window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No SDR, BDR or account executive opening is listed. The Strategic Accounts opening is for an account manager, which does not qualify.

launched_6mo.notes: The November 9, 2026 changelog introduced Stripe Link wallet support for Sprites, enabling agents to request one-time purchase cards approved by users.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On July 24, 2026, Fly.io announced that Scott Johnston had joined as CEO and a board member.

crm_stack_signal.notes: HubSpot is listed for customer relationship management; Customer.io for newsletters and transactional email.
